name: inflect-compliance-docs-site
description: The two documentation sites — the user help site and the developer site — built with Starlight from docs/. See docs/docs-site.md.

scripts.build: npm run reference && npm run stage && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --root users && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --root developers && node scripts/assemble.js
scripts.dev:users: npm run reference && npm run stage && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --root users
scripts.dev:developers: npm run reference && npm run stage && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --root developers
